abstract: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) encompasses several entities including complete (CHM) and partial (PHM) hydatidiform mole (HM), malignant choriocarcinoma, and placental-site trophoblastic tumor. HMs are genetically abnormal, nonviable conceptions, which are associated with significantly increased risk for development of complications due to persistence of abnormal trophoblast (persistent GTN; pGTN), which occurs following 15% of CHM and 0.5% of PHM. Diagnostic histological features of HM are present in the first trimester but these features differ from those traditionally described in the later second trimester. The characteristic morphological findings of early HM include aspects of villous dysmorphism and abnormal villous trophoblast hyperplasia, with other specific features allowing reliable distinction between CHM and PHM. Optimal management of molar disease depends on its early histological identification and subsequent surveillance by measurement of maternal human chorionic gonoadotropin (hCG) for detection of pGTN based on rising or plateuing hCG levels such that early effective treatment is possible.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)には、完全奇胎(CHM)および部分奇胎(PHM)、悪性絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などの病型が含まれる。胞状奇胎は遺伝的に異常で生存不能な妊娠であり、持続性の異常な栄養膜細胞によるさまざまな合併症のリスクが著しく高くなる。持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(pGTN)は、完全奇胎の約15%、部分奇胎の0.5%に生じる。胞状奇胎の診断的組織学的特徴は妊娠初期から存在するが、これらの特徴は妊娠中期後半で従来記載されてきたものとは異なる。初期の胞状奇胎の特徴的な形態学的所見には、絨毛異形成と異常な絨毛栄養膜細胞の過形成が含まれ、その他の特徴により完全奇胎と部分奇胎を確実に区別できる。胞状奇胎の適切な管理は、早期の組織学的同定と、母体ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の測定による経過観察に依存する。hCG値の上昇または横ばいに基づいて持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を検出すれば、早期の有効な治療が可能となる。
